additional_information: When movies are added/removed from the watchlist, entries should be created/deleted from the database.
To manually reset the database, stop the running server and then restart it.
Running the test cases will also restore the database to its initial state.
The code repository may intentionally contain other issues that are unrelated to this specific task.
In Run and Debug mode the frontend may start before the backend (and database seeding) is ready; reload the preview once the backend is up.
